"Outputs the binary equivalent of an XOR operation on each bit. Since every input is 10.0, a normal XOR binary truth table will work."

Functionality

The XOR Gate has 2 inputs and 1 output. When only 1 input has a signal, there is an output. When both inputs have a signal, there is no output. When there is no signals at all, there is no output.
